metadata.name: Gaia DR4 1M
metadata.description: Star catalog made from a selection of Gaia DR4 with only the very best stars in terms of parallax relative error, yielding to ~1.3 million stars. Contains all stars with up to 0.3%/0.001% bright/faint parallax relative error, and all Hipparcos stars. The cut between bright and faint stars is at 13.1 mag. The stars in this catalog are all loaded into graphics memory, this is not a LOD (level-of-detail) catalog.
metadata.creator: Toni Sagristà, tsagrista@ari.uni-heidelberg.de

metadata.name: Gaia DR4 2M
metadata.description: Star catalog made from a selection of Gaia DR4 stars based on parallax relative error, with ~1.94 million stars. Contains all stars with up to 0.4%/0.002% bright/faint parallax relative error, and all Hipparcos stars. The cut between bright and faint stars is at 13.1 mag. The stars in this catalog are all loaded into graphics memory, this is not a LOD (level-of-detail) catalog.
metadata.creator: Toni Sagristà, tsagrista@ari.uni-heidelberg.de

metadata.name: Gaia DR4 4M (LOD)
metadata.description: Star catalog with a selection of Gaia DR4 stars based on parallax relative error, containing ~4.29 million stars. Contains all stars with up to 1.0%/0.008% bright/faint parallax relative error, and all Hipparcos stars. The cut between bright and faint stars is at 13.1 mag. This is a LOD (level-of-detail) catalog: stars are streamed from disk as they are needed.
metadata.creator: Toni Sagristà, tsagrista@ari.uni-heidelberg.de

metadata.name: Gaia DR4 default
metadata.description: Star catalog based on Gaia DR4 with only the very best stars in terms of parallax signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Contains all stars with SNR better than 5 for bright stars, and 66 for faint stars, and all Hipparcos stars. This is a LOD (level-of-detail) catalog: stars are streamed from disk as they are needed.
metadata.creator: Toni Sagristà, tsagrista@ari.uni-heidelberg.de
